name: Dodecahedron Subdivision Normal Quantization
definition: A static method for generating a set of normal vector directions by tessellating a unit sphere using a subdivided regular dodecahedron.
summary: Dodecahedron Subdivision Normal Quantization is a static method generating 240 nearly uniform normal vectors by tessellating a dodecahedron, avoiding the uneven gradient distribution caused by octahedron-based quantizers.
